---
title: "Inspect the DietSwap outputs"
---

Open `results/dietswap/tables/alpha-diversity.tsv` after the run. Reconcile its sample count and group labels with your selected metadata.

Inspect all three figures and locate the table behind each. Record the sample with the lowest and highest Shannon values and check its count total and observed richness.
